variants.label: Updated mobile — header, search and chat
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, mobile website UI mockup refinement. Edit this existing mobile screenshot rather than redesigning it. Preserve ALL wording verbatim, every feature, burgundy/ivory palette, exact logo artwork where present, hybrid serif display headings with upright sans-serif UI and body, photo subjects, clear contrast, and generous readable body/control sizing. Keep the SAME mobile viewport width and scale; do NOT shrink the whole page to save vertical space. Return a shorter scrolling screenshot when the requested spacing reductions remove height; do not fill the saved space with enlarged images or blank space. No phone frame or browser chrome.
Make exactly these refinements to the supplied TOP mobile scroll section:
1. Shorten the hero photograph region by about 15% in HEIGHT at the same width. Keep the entire serif motto 'Bringing families together' and upright sans subtitle 'One rescue at a time'. Both dog and cat faces must remain fully visible and directly beside one another. Recompose the photo crop to remove excess background and blanket, not their faces. Keep the existing masthead logo, Donate, Menu unchanged. Do not add hero CTA. Do not reduce body or control text sizes elsewhere.
2. Tighten the vertical spacing around the search panel heading and View all animals link slightly (about 8 CSS pixels total) so the species selector starts sooner. Preserve the exact heading 'Find your furry best friend', all species tabs, Age and Size fields, full-width 'Show matching pets →' button and shadow-free bordered panel.
3. Compact ONLY surplus spacing within the chat area: reduce gaps between the search button and divider, divider and Ask Pets4Luv heading, heading and textarea, textarea and Send button, Send and helper text. Aim for consistent 8–12 CSS pixel gaps instead of large empty gaps, saving about 35–45 CSS pixels overall. Preserve the quiet regular gray full phrase 'OR tell us what you’re looking for' and thin flanking rules, the inline Ask Pets4Luv icon/heading, MULTILINE textarea with exact placeholder 'Tell us about your ideal companion', separate right-aligned burgundy Send button below, and full helper text 'You can also ask about adoption, pet care, or volunteering.' Keep the textarea comfortably tall (roughly 75–80 CSS pixels), keep Send button touch-sized, and keep all text comfortably readable. Do not overlap controls or turn textarea into tiny single-line field.
The total scroll capture should visibly shorten due to these local reductions, with the same width and same font/control scale. Preserve all other details and end after the chat panel. No weekly section in this image.
